name: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B Pro v2
description: Free 4s AI video from a photo. Key unlocks full length.

paragraphs: Turn a still image into smooth motion with Wan 2.2 I2V 14B. Add your own LoRAs, shape the prompt, continue a scene, and see an estimated ZeroGPU cost before you generate.
features: Shared LoRA library, with one link per adapter. Wan adapters usually contain separate High and Low expert files. Paste a model page such as once and the library finds both halves, whether they are published as two files…

Bring your own LoRA. Five custom slots accept a Hugging Face repository, a file from a repository, or a CivitAI download link. Each slot has separate High and Low inputs, and downloads are cached. For gated CivitAI…

Search CivitAI in the app. Search results show the title, version, file, size, downloads, base model, and trigger words. Send a result directly to a custom slot, or identify an existing link by its title and version.

Private built-in presets. The bundled-adapter catalogue is loaded at startup from the private repository named by LORACATALOGREPO. If the variable is unset, custom LoRA slots still work and the Space simply starts…

Fast presets. One click sets steps, flow shift, and scheduler together, including lightx2v Lightning options at 4, 6, and 8 steps. The checkpoint is already a Lightning merge, so the built-in preset is a good starting…

whatItDoes.text: Turn a still image into smooth motion with Wan 2.2 I2V 14B. Add your own LoRAs, shape the prompt, continue a scene, and see an estimated ZeroGPU cost before you generate.

requirements.text: For gated CivitAI models, add CIVITAITOKEN under Settings → Variables and secrets; browser sign-in does not authenticate downloads made by the Space.
